results.title: First visit loads the shell with no errors
results.expected: Exercise tab, picker and both start buttons; no console or page errors
results.actual: shell ready; DCL 127 ms, load 127 ms

results.title: [sim] Complete session saves once and shows triage for that session
results.expected: +1 session row; outcome card lists agent tool calls; run log has a run for that session id
results.actual: session 197 saved once (3 reps, source simulation); 5 tool calls recorded for it; 1 POST

results.title: [sim] Rapid double-click on Finish
results.expected: exactly one session row
results.actual: one row

results.title: [stub] Save fails with 500, then retry
results.expected: error shown, reps kept, a retry control saves exactly one row
results.actual: retry saved one row

results.title: [stub] Response lost after the server wrote the session, then retry
results.expected: no duplicate row (idempotent save)
results.actual: server deduplicated the retry: one row

results.title: [stub] Save answers 401
results.expected: clear message, no crash, retry available
results.actual: "Your sign-in has expired or does not allow this. Sign in again, then retry. Your reps are " + retry

results.title: [stub] Save answers 429
results.expected: clear message, no crash, retry available
results.actual: "Too many requests right now. Wait a few seconds, then retry. Your reps are kept." + retry

results.title: [stub] Save answers 503
results.expected: clear message, no crash, retry available
results.actual: "The server could not save the session (HTTP 503). Try again in a moment. Your reps are kep" + retry

results.title: [stub] Malformed 200 response to save
results.expected: no crash; error shown; data not lost
results.actual: "The server answered in an unexpected format, so the save could not be confirmed." + retry

results.title: [stub] Offline at save time, back online, retry
results.expected: error while offline; one row after reconnect
results.actual: offline: "No connection to the app. Check the network, then "; one row after reconnect

results.title: [sim] Slow save, user leaves the tab before it answers
results.expected: no page error; saved once; Exercise tab fresh on return
results.actual: late response handled; one row

results.title: [sim] Switching patient mid-session
results.expected: reps of patient A are never saved to patient B
results.actual: session ended on switch (rAF 168/s after)

results.title: [sim] Refresh mid-session
results.expected: no partial row written; app reloads clean
results.actual: nothing written; reps reset

results.title: [sim] Back-to-back sessions and stale results
results.expected: second session starts clean; the first result never reappears over it
results.actual: no stale outcome over the running session

results.title: [synthetic-cam] Camera with no person in frame
results.expected: tracking never starts, 0 reps, Finish refuses, nothing saved
results.actual: status "Step into frame to calibrate—°ready"; · 79 fps; Finish refused; loop ready in 7212 ms

results.title: [synthetic-cam] Stop releases the camera and the loop
results.expected: all tracks ended; inference rAF stops
results.actual: tracks 1 → 0; rAF 89/s → 0/s

results.title: [synthetic-cam] Leaving the Exercise tab mid-session
results.expected: camera released, loop stopped
results.actual: tracks 0; rAF 0/s

results.title: [stub] getUserMedia permission denied
results.expected: clear message with a Demo simulation fallback; no stream
results.actual: "Camera permission was denied. Allow the camera in the address bar, or switch to "

results.title: [stub] getUserMedia no camera
results.expected: clear message with a Demo simulation fallback; no stream
results.actual: "No usable camera found. Connect one, or switch to Demo simulation. forced by QA"

results.title: [stub] getUserMedia camera in use by another app
results.expected: clear message with a Demo simulation fallback; no stream
results.actual: "The camera is in use by another app or could not start. Close other apps using i"

results.title: [synthetic-cam][stub] Model file fails to load
results.expected: error shown and the camera is released
results.actual: "The vision model could not load. Check the connection and try again, o"; camera released

results.title: [synthetic-cam][stub] Simulation chosen while the camera request is pending
results.expected: no hidden live camera once the simulation runs
results.actual: start buttons disabled while the camera request is pending

results.title: [synthetic-cam] Camera disconnects mid-session
results.expected: the app says the camera stopped, stops the loop, and offers a way forward
results.actual: "The camera stopped (unplugged, turned off, or taken by another app). Start it ag"; loop stopped

results.title: [synthetic-cam][stub] Leave the Exercise tab while the camera request is pending
results.expected: the late camera grant is released immediately; no hidden camera
results.actual: camera granted after leaving was released; rAF 0/s

results.title: [synthetic-cam] Repeated start/stop x8
results.expected: no leaked tracks; loop stops each time
results.actual: 8 streams opened, 0 live; rAF 0/s

results.title: [synthetic-cam]+[sim] What leaves the browser during camera use and a saved session
results.expected: only same-origin app API and static assets; the session POST carries scored numbers only
results.actual: same-origin only; 4 API routes; session POST 447 bytes with fields patient_id, exercise_key, side, started_at, ended_at, pain_score, source, reps, client_ref; no storage, no websockets

results.title: Ask: prompt injection and markup in the question
results.expected: treated as text; no dialog; no data change; answer says what it can answer
results.actual: no dialog; 4 patients unchanged; rule-based answers rendered as text

results.title: Agents tab: roster, Run now, rate limit
results.expected: two agent cards; a run appears in the log; an immediate second run is refused politely
results.actual: run recorded; second run refused with a message

results.title: Add patient: wrong code, then demo code
results.expected: wrong code refused; 2026 creates the patient and selects them
results.actual: refused ("That clinic code is not valid. Ask your "), then created and selected "QA Patient (me)"

results.title: [stub] Signed-out visitor sees the sign-in page; sign-up conflict message
results.expected: landing page; 409 explained
results.actual: "An account with that email already exists. Sign in instead."; no horizontal overflow at 390 px

results.title: No horizontal scrolling across tabs and viewports
results.expected: scrollWidth ≤ innerWidth on every tab at 360, 390, 768, 1366, 1920 and a 200% zoom proxy (683 px)
results.actual: 24 tab × viewport combinations fit

results.title: Keyboard-only start of a session
results.expected: Demo simulation reachable by Tab and starts with Enter; focus ring visible
results.actual: reached and started by keyboard; focus outline "solid 2px"

results.title: Lost tracking is communicated and the reading is not shown as live
results.expected: status says tracking is lost and the angle is visibly marked as not live
results.actual: "Step into frame to calibrate"; gauge dimmed (rgb(138, 150, 179))

results.title: [sim] Sustained 20 s session and 10 repeat sessions
results.expected: stable frame rate; heap, listeners and DOM nodes do not grow without bound
results.actual: 166 fps; 145 fps at 4× CPU throttle; heap 3.3 → 4.5 MB, listeners 200 → 204, nodes 452 → 454

results.title: [synthetic-cam] Inference loop rate with the pose model (headless, no person)
results.expected: loop runs; frame rate recorded
results.actual: camera + model ready in 1745 ms; 79 fps on 1280x720 synthetic video
